verdict.rationale: Moneybird's own docs show that invoices can be created on desktop or mobile, and that customers can pay online via iDEAL, QR code, direct debit, credit card or mobile payments. Nothing in the evidence shows explicit sending or tracking of when an invoice is viewed or paid; the generic webhook line is too vague to count. Missing for 10: explicit invoice sending (email or link delivery), invoice viewed/opened tracking, payment-status visibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: You can create invoices from your desktop or directly in the Moneybird mobile app, and Moneybird takes care of the rest.
Make it easy for your customers to pay, for example via iDEAL, QR code, or direct debit.
Provide payment options such as iDEAL, credit card, or mobile payments.
